_comment: Toggle which 2014-era source books are included. 'included' gates ALL content (races, subraces, feats, spells, items, backgrounds). 'racesExtra' additionally allows RACES/SUBRACES (only) from these books, without pulling in their feats/spells/items/backgrounds - use it to add missing player races while keeping the file small. 2024 sources (XPHB, XDMG, XMM, etc.) are always excluded regardless of these lists.

_notes.WBtW: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight (Fairy, Harengon)
_notes.EEPC: Elemental Evil Player's Companion (Aarakocra, Genasi, Deep Gnome/Svirfneblin)
_notes.ERLW: Eberron: Rising from the Last War (Changeling, Kalashtar, Shifter, Warforged - 2014 versions)
_notes.GGR: Guildmasters' Guide to Ravnica (Centaur, Loxodon, Minotaur, Simic Hybrid, Vedalken)
_notes.MOT: Mythic Odysseys of Theros (Centaur, Minotaur, Leonin, Satyr)
_notes.VRGR: Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft (Dhampir, Hexblood)
_notes.AAG: Astral Adventurer's Guide (Giff, Hadozee, Autognome, Thri-kreen)
